description: Take a close look of the fruits that you bare. A bad day does not equate a bad life #selflove #selfimprovement
transcript: Your ability to remain stable during instability says a lot about the fruits that you bear. In my day-to-day, I am focused on self-sufficiency, sustainability, creating structure to keep my internal world, to keep my nervous system, and alignment, even when destruction arrives. A bad day does not equate a bad life. That I do, I move in grace knowing that I don't have the luxury of crashing out.
